sounds.name: Epic Whoosh 01
sounds.desc: A massive, sub-heavy epic whoosh with a 1 s wind-up and long tail; use for a big zoom-out, title reveal or major section change.

sounds.name: Epic Whoosh 02
sounds.desc: A distant, tonal epic whoosh with a deep sub body and a 2.5 s wind-up; use under slow reveals, logo moments or a big scene change.

sounds.name: Epic Whoosh 02 Cut
sounds.desc: Cut-ready version of Epic Whoosh 02: a 0.5 s lead-in to the peak and a short tail. Land the peak on the cut.

sounds.name: Epic Whoosh 03
sounds.desc: An epic, noisy air whoosh that peaks after about 1 s; use for a weighty cut, zoom transition or B-roll insert.

sounds.name: Ringing Echo Whoosh 01
sounds.desc: A quick-windup whoosh that peaks at about 0.5 s with a slight ringing tone and echoing tail; good for a punch-in, text card fly-in or section change.

sounds.name: Bitcrush Whoosh 01
sounds.desc: A dark, slightly bitcrushed whoosh with an 800 ms wind-up and long tail; use for moody scene transitions on AI or dystopian-tech topics.

sounds.name: Bitcrush Whoosh 01 Cut
sounds.desc: Cut-ready version of Bitcrush Whoosh 01: a 0.5 s lead-in to the peak and a short tail. Land the peak on the cut.

sounds.name: Bitcrush Whoosh 02
sounds.desc: A noisy, low whoosh with a subtle bitcrushed grain and a 1 s wind-up; suits transitions into data, AI or dashboard B-roll.

sounds.name: Pshew Swish 01
sounds.desc: Loud, noisy 'psheww' swish with a decaying tail; use for a punch-in or a panel flying in with some energy.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Pshew Swish 02
sounds.desc: Softer, slightly darker 'pshuww' swish; use for lighter slide-ins or text cards entering frame.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: UI Swish 01
sounds.desc: Very short bright 'fshing' flick of about 0.2 s; use when a small text card or icon flicks onto screen.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: UI Swish 02
sounds.desc: Airy bright swish of about 0.7 s that peaks mid-way; use for graphics or cards sliding in on a cut.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Riser 01
sounds.desc: An intense tonal riser layered with digital screeching and glitches that peaks around 10 s then tails off; back-time it into a crash, error or big reveal.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Riser 01 2s
sounds.desc: 2-second cut of Digital Tonal Riser 01: builds for 2 s and peaks at the end. Land the end on the reveal frame.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Riser 01 4s
sounds.desc: 4-second cut of Digital Tonal Riser 01: builds for 4 s and peaks at the end. Land the end on the reveal frame.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Riser 02
sounds.desc: An epic tonal riser with digital noises and screeches that builds for about 15 s and stops at its peak; back-time the end into a hard cut or hit.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Riser 03
sounds.desc: An epic tonal riser with digital noise and screeches that swells for nearly 18 s and stops at its peak; use the last few seconds into a big reveal.

sounds.name: Digital Tonal Riser 04
sounds.desc: An epic tonal riser with screeching digital noise and solid low end that peaks at the 15 s mark; back-time it into a result or product reveal.

sounds.name: Glitch Data Riser 01
sounds.desc: An abrupt squelch then a short rising glitch stutter that peaks at about 1.5 s, for leading into a glitchy reveal or an AI result.

sounds.name: Glitch Data Riser 01 1s
sounds.desc: 1-second cut of Glitch Data Riser 01: builds for 1 s and peaks at the end. Land the end on the reveal frame.

sounds.name: Glitch Data Riser 02
sounds.desc: A shorter squelch-to-rising glitch stutter that builds clearly to a peak at about 1 s, for a quick techy build into a cut or stat.

sounds.name: Rumble Data Riser 01
sounds.desc: A rumbling riser that gathers screeching digital noises and lands with a short reverberant tail; build into a data reveal or 'message sent' payoff.

sounds.name: Rumble Data Riser 01 2s
sounds.desc: 2-second cut of Rumble Data Riser 01: builds for 2 s and peaks at the end. Land the end on the reveal frame.

sounds.name: Rumble Data Riser 01 4s
sounds.desc: 4-second cut of Rumble Data Riser 01: builds for 4 s and peaks at the end. Land the end on the reveal frame.

sounds.name: Rumble Data Riser 02
sounds.desc: A 10 s rumbling riser that gets joined by screeching digital noise and cuts off at its peak; back-time it into a smash cut or hit.

sounds.name: Rumble Data Riser 02 1s
sounds.desc: 1-second cut of Rumble Data Riser 02: builds for 1 s and peaks at the end. Land the end on the reveal frame.

sounds.name: Rumble Data Riser 02 4s
sounds.desc: 4-second cut of Rumble Data Riser 02: builds for 4 s and peaks at the end. Land the end on the reveal frame.

sounds.name: Rumble Data Riser 03
sounds.desc: A rumbling riser swamped by harsh screeching noise and glitches, ending abruptly at full intensity; use for a system-overload or 'everything breaks' moment.

sounds.name: Rumble Data Riser 03 4s
sounds.desc: 4-second cut of Rumble Data Riser 03: builds for 4 s and peaks at the end. Land the end on the reveal frame.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 01
sounds.desc: A loose, reverberant cinematic boom with a slight echo and a long ~6 s tail; land a title card or big statement, fading the tail if voice continues.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 01 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Cinematic Boom 01: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 02
sounds.desc: A deep cinematic boom with strong low end and a fast attack; hit the hook's first frame or a key stat landing.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 02 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Cinematic Boom 02: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 03
sounds.desc: A tight, kick-like boom heavy in sub bass; punch an emphasis word, a beat drop or a smash cut.

sounds.name: Cinematic Boom 03 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Cinematic Boom 03: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Digital Boom 01
sounds.desc: A loose, echoing boom with digital time-stretch artifacts in the tail; land a glitchy title, a 'system' reveal or an AI-topic key point.

sounds.name: Digital Boom 01 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Digital Boom 01: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Digital Boom 02
sounds.desc: A reverberant cinematic boom with a bitcrushed, pixelated edge; pair it with glitch transitions or a pixel-text title landing.

sounds.name: Digital Boom 02 Short
sounds.desc: Short-tail cut of Digital Boom 02: the hit with a 1.2 s tail, for when the next line follows quickly.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 01
sounds.desc: A 1.7-second digital horn blast like a glitched fog horn, a braam-style hit for a hook opener or a system-failure beat.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 02
sounds.desc: A 2-second digital horn that swells to its loudest point right at the end, for leading hard into a cut or a reveal.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 03
sounds.desc: A short 1.4-second pure, steady digital horn tone, for a clean braam under a title or a bold statement.

sounds.name: Digital Fog Horn 04
sounds.desc: The deepest of the digital fog horns, swelling over 2 seconds then fading, for a heavy dramatic reveal or a hook opener.

sounds.name: Gritty Crunch Boom 01
sounds.desc: A short, sub-heavy, crunchy explosion hit decaying in under a second, for landing a stat or a beat drop; it is game-flavoured, so use it sparingly.

sounds.name: Gritty Crunch Boom 02
sounds.desc: A 1.5-second deep crunchy explosion with heavy sub and a rumbling tail, for a big reveal or a title slam.

sounds.name: Gritty Crunch Boom 03
sounds.desc: A 2-second, very deep, sub-dominated boom with a long rumble, for the end of a riser or a logo reveal.

sounds.name: Low Sub Boom 01
sounds.desc: A deep 2-second sub boom with a soft attack and nothing above about 500 Hz, for layering under a stat landing, logo reveal or beat drop.

sounds.name: Short Sub Drop 01
sounds.desc: A short pure low tone diving down in pitch, mostly sub bass; use under a stat landing or emphasis word as a quick bass drop.

sounds.name: Corrupted Data Loop 01
sounds.desc: Short 1.6-second burst of corrupted readout chatter with matched edges; use as a glitch transition or loop it under a broken-screen beat.

sounds.name: Data Corruption Chatter 01
sounds.desc: Three-quarters of a second of churning digital chatter that hits its loudest spike right before stopping dead; cut to the next shot on that spike.

sounds.name: Digital Static Burst 01
sounds.desc: A loud, bright static hit with an instant attack and a clean decay, a crisp glitch transition or error flash.

sounds.name: Glitch Build 01
sounds.desc: Nearly two-second glitch build that starts from silence, grows into dense crackling and stops hard at full level, perfect for leading into a smash cut or reveal.

sounds.name: Glitch Burst 01
sounds.desc: Hot, fast-onset digital glitch burst that hits at once and decays cleanly over 0.7 s; ideal for a glitch cut or a word distorting onto screen.

sounds.name: Glitch Burst 02
sounds.desc: Tight half-second digital glitch hit with an instant attack and clean decay; perfect for a fast glitch cut or punchy text glitch-in.

sounds.name: Glitch Burst 03
sounds.desc: A 295 ms digital glitch that hits early and decays to silence, a clean all-round glitch transition.

sounds.name: Glitch Burst 04
sounds.desc: A 240 ms glitch that peaks early and decays fully to silence, a clean general-purpose glitch transition.

sounds.name: Glitch Crackle Loop 01
sounds.desc: A loud bright static crackle loop of 3.8 s with even edges, for sustained screen-glitch or signal-loss sections.

sounds.name: Glitch Crackle Tick 01
sounds.desc: An instant 0.11 s bright glitch tick that decays, for crisp text glitches and HUD element blips.

sounds.name: Glitch Data Burst 01
sounds.desc: A punchy, loud 100 ms tonal glitch that hits hard and decays cleanly; use as the main sound on a glitch cut or error beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Data Burst 02
sounds.desc: A 110 ms glitch burst with an instant hit and a clean decay; use on a glitch transition or a 'system broke' beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Hit 01
sounds.desc: Mid-low glitch crunch with sub weight that peaks late and decays fully to silence in under a second, good for landing a key point or a glitch punch-in.

sounds.name: Glitch Hit 02
sounds.desc: Loud mid-range glitch hit that peaks early and decays cleanly to silence, ideal on a cut, a punch-in or a stat landing with a digital edge.

sounds.name: Glitch Punch Dark 01
sounds.desc: A 0.4 s dark glitch hit with heavy low end that decays cleanly; use on a punch-in or key point that wants a glitchy impact.

sounds.name: Glitch Static Short 01
sounds.desc: A tight, loud 0.2 s burst of bright static, for a sharp glitch cut or a screen-tear accent.

sounds.name: Glitch Stutter 01
sounds.desc: A loud 725 ms glitch meltdown that hits hard and decays to silence, a go-to for a full system-failure or error-screen beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Stutter Burst 01
sounds.desc: A clean 0.18 s glitch hit with an instant attack and fully decayed tail, ideal for a tight glitch cut or text pop.

sounds.name: Low Glitch Hit 01
sounds.desc: A deep, sub-heavy digital thump that drops to silence in 200 ms, a glitchy low hit for a stat landing or error beat.

sounds.name: Tonal Screech Glitch 01
sounds.desc: Bright, screeching tonal glitch with a razor-sharp attack and a clean 0.7-second decay; ideal for a snappy glitch transition between screen recordings.

sounds.name: Bitcrush Chatter 01
sounds.desc: One-second mid-range bitcrushed chatter that ends on its loudest moment, suited to a glitch transition straight into the next shot.

sounds.name: Bright Screen Tear 01
sounds.desc: Short, bright and fairly tonal 0.5 s digital zip that cuts off hard; use for a screen tear, RGB split or caption glitch-in.

sounds.name: Bright Screen Tear 02
sounds.desc: Very short 0.36 s bright digital tear; a quick accent for an RGB split, flicker or caption glitch.

sounds.name: Digital Static Burst 02
sounds.desc: Loud bright static burst that peaks early and fades cleanly over 1.5 s, for a static wipe or signal-loss transition.

sounds.name: Glitch Error Swell 01
sounds.desc: Half-second glitch error that swells to a loud peak then fades; good under an 'access denied' screen or a system-failure beat.

sounds.name: Glitch Stutter 02
sounds.desc: Half-second digital stutter with an instant attack and a bright, crunchy body; use for a screen-tear transition or text distorting in.

sounds.name: Glitch Swell Cut 01
sounds.desc: Heavy, tonal digital distortion that swells for 0.4 seconds and cuts off at its loudest point; drop it right before a hard cut so the glitch slams into the next shot.

sounds.name: Glitch Swell Cut 02
sounds.desc: Short 0.75-second glitch swell that ends abruptly at full level; cut to the next shot on its last frame.

sounds.name: Glitch Swell In 01
sounds.desc: A 0.17 s glitch that swells up from quiet and cuts off, good for sucking into a hard cut or reveal.

sounds.name: Harsh Data Buzzer 01
sounds.desc: A 0.45 s gritty digital buzzer that hits at once and decays slightly, for an error message or a failed-attempt beat.

sounds.name: Harsh Power Glitch 01
sounds.desc: A 1-second harsh, tonal digital burst that builds to a peak near its end, for a glitchy power-up or a disruptive transition.

sounds.name: Intercom Squelch Off 01
sounds.desc: 140 ms static squelch that pops and decays naturally, for a radio sign-off or a soft glitch on a cut.

sounds.name: System Failure Glitch 01
sounds.desc: Almost two seconds of chaotic glitching with a body of low end that decays cleanly to silence, good for an error or system-crash beat.

sounds.name: Tonal Glitch Warble 01
sounds.desc: Quieter, darker and fairly tonal 0.6 s digital warble like a detuned signal; use for radio interference or a soft error beat.

sounds.name: Tonal Static Loop 01
sounds.desc: Bright ten-second loop of tonal screeching interference, for a radio-tuning transition or a glitchy HUD texture.

sounds.name: Bright Select Ping 01
sounds.desc: A bright, tonal 340 ms digital ping with a clean decay; use to accept a choice or as a light accent on a highlighted keyword.

sounds.name: Dark Digital Click 01
sounds.desc: A tight 20 ms low digital click with a clean fast decay; ideal for real cursor clicks and button presses in screen recordings.

sounds.name: Dark Digital Click 02
sounds.desc: The darkest of the set, a 20 ms rounded tonal tock; great for understated clicks and toggles in a premium app demo.

sounds.name: Dark Digital Click 03
sounds.desc: A 20 ms low-mid digital click with an extremely fast, clean decay; a precise sound for real cursor clicks.

sounds.name: Digital Blip Press 01
sounds.desc: A warm tonal 70 ms blip that decays cleanly; ideal for a confirm tap or a button press in an app demo.

sounds.name: Select Confirm Tap 01
sounds.desc: A rounded low-mid confirm tap that decays cleanly to silence; a polished choice for accept or enable actions.

sounds.name: Select Confirm Tap 02
sounds.desc: A rounded low confirm tap with a warm sub layer and clean decay; good for a satisfying accept or submit.

sounds.name: Trackpad Click 01
sounds.desc: A tight, soft MacBook Pro trackpad click with a clean thunk; perfect for cursor clicks and button presses in Mac screen recordings.

sounds.name: Trackpad Click 02

sounds.name: Trackpad Double Click 02

sounds.name: Warm Digital Click 02

sounds.name: Dark Digital Click 04

sounds.name: Digital Click 02

sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Sine Bloop 02
sounds.desc: A soft, dark, rounded bloop of about 145 ms, slightly lower than 01; use for gentle list items or icons appearing.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Sine Bloop 03
sounds.desc: A soft rounded bloop of about 200 ms, the highest of the set; use for a gentle pop as text or a card appears.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Soft Synth Pluck 01
sounds.desc: A clean, tonal 100 ms synth pluck with a fast decay; use it under a caption word or a list item appearing.

sounds.name: Soft Synth Pluck 02
sounds.desc: A slightly longer, mellow tonal synth pluck at about 160 ms; use it for an icon, sticker or bullet point landing.

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 01
sounds.desc: A clean, mid-pitched tonal UI blip with a short decay. Works for a button confirm or a list item popping in.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 02
sounds.desc: A soft, mid-pitched tonal blip with a quick decay. Use it for bullet points stacking in or a gentle button confirm.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 03
sounds.desc: A higher-pitched, short tonal ping-blip. Use it for a quick confirm, a stat chip appearing or an ascending list sequence.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Tonal UI Blip 04
sounds.desc: A mid-pitched tonal blip with a slightly wide stereo image and a 200 ms decay. Use it for list items stacking in or a soft confirm.
sounds.credit_line: "UI buttons | Sound effects pack + GLITCHES" by kasse (https://pknm.itch.io/ui-buttons-sound-effects-pack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Woop Click 01
sounds.desc: Short bright 'woop' click with a quick pitch sweep and no tail; use when a text box, icon or list item pops in.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: SLR Burst Shutter 03
sounds.desc: A 1.8-second SLR burst of rapid shutters; use it under a quick photo montage or a burst of freeze-frames.

sounds.name: Autofocus Motor 01
sounds.desc: An 11-second take of a DSLR lens autofocus motor buzzing and hunting; cut a short whirr under a punch-in to fake a camera zoom.

sounds.name: Instamatic Film Wind 01
sounds.desc: A second, shorter Instamatic film-wind ratchet; rotate it with the others after shutter clicks in a run of snapshot cards.

sounds.name: Instamatic Film Wind 02
sounds.desc: A bright, slightly longer Instamatic film-wind ratchet; good for a retro snapshot moment or a photo being 'advanced' to the next frame.

sounds.name: Instamatic Shutter 01
sounds.desc: A light, tight plastic shutter click from an Instamatic camera; use it on a casual snapshot or a freeze-frame in a playful photo sequence.

sounds.name: Instamatic Shutter 02
sounds.desc: A second tight, plasticky Instamatic shutter click; rotate it with the first for multiple snapshot beats.

sounds.name: Paparazzi Shutters 01
sounds.desc: A stereo flurry of several cameras firing like paparazzi on a red carpet; use it for 'everyone is talking about this' or fame and hype moments.

sounds.name: Paparazzi Shutters 02
sounds.desc: A second, shorter stereo paparazzi flurry of overlapping camera shutters; good under a press or headline-wall montage.

sounds.name: SLR Shutter Single 02
sounds.desc: A second single SLR shutter trigger; rotate it with the first when you have several screenshots or freeze-frames in a row.

sounds.name: Vintage Camera Shutter 01
sounds.desc: An old mechanical camera shutter firing with a metallic ring in the tail; use it for vintage photo reveals or before/after stills.

sounds.name: Digital Camera Trigger 01
sounds.desc: A bright, tonal camera trigger dominated by a high electronic ring (likely a compact camera's focus beep or shutter tone); use it for a digital snapshot or a focus-lock beat.

sounds.name: Flash Powder Poof 01
sounds.desc: A quick old-time flash-powder ignition poof with a short burst tail; use it on a white-flash transition or a vintage photo reveal.

sounds.name: Micro Tonal Tick 01
sounds.desc: A tiny 15 ms bright tonal tick; repeat it for a number counter rolling up or for list ticks.

sounds.name: Micro Tonal Tick 02
sounds.desc: An ultra-short 10 ms pure tick; perfect for rapid number counter steps or digit flips.

sounds.name: Micro Tonal Tick 03
sounds.desc: A pure-tone 20 ms tick that fades quickly; ideal as a clean counter tick on KPI numbers.

sounds.name: Micro Tonal Tick 04
sounds.desc: A clean 20 ms bright tonal tick; use for counter digits rolling or list items ticking in.

sounds.name: Digital Count Tick 01
sounds.desc: A tiny 20 ms digital tick; repeat it for each number step in a counter or KPI card counting up.

sounds.name: Biohazard Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A dry, looping sci-fi alarm buzzer that swells into each cycle; use under a warning or containment-breach style beat.

sounds.name: Concise Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A bright, crisp looping sci-fi buzzer with an instant attack; use for a sharp system-warning or error-screen moment.

sounds.name: Cookies Stolen Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A short 1.6 s noisy sci-fi buzzer loop; use for a quick security-breach or 'data stolen' warning beat.

sounds.name: Decontamination Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A 10 s dry sci-fi alarm loop like a lab decontamination cycle; use as a tense warning bed under a 'something is wrong' section.

sounds.name: HDD Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A loud 10 s dry sci-fi alarm loop with a machine-like, hard-drive character; use under a system-failure or crash beat.

sounds.name: Incoming Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A 2 s dry sci-fi alert buzzer loop; use for an 'incoming' warning or a trouble alert popping on screen.

sounds.name: Incoming Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of a 2 s sci-fi alert buzzer loop; use for an incoming-threat warning with more space.

sounds.name: Invaders Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A dry looping sci-fi alarm buzzer for an 'under attack' or intruder warning beat.

sounds.name: Not A Drill Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A dry, mono looping emergency alarm with an instant start; use for an urgent 'this is not a drill' warning or a hook pattern interrupt.

sounds.name: Not A Drill Alarm 02
sounds.desc: The reverberant version of an urgent emergency alarm loop; use for a big, roomy 'not a drill' warning moment.

sounds.name: Stern Alarm 01
sounds.desc: A stern, full-band 3.2 s sci-fi buzzer loop with a hard attack; use for a firm 'denied' or warning beat.

sounds.name: Data Drill Machine 01
sounds.desc: A 21-second mid-toned digital whir that sounds like a drill, for a layer under an AI building something or a machine-at-work moment.

sounds.name: Data Drill Machine 02
sounds.desc: A steady 6.6-second sub-heavy digital drill grind, for a short heavy machine layer under a 'building the system' moment.

sounds.name: Data Drill Machine 03
sounds.desc: A quieter 13.6-second low digital drill rumble, for a subtle mechanical bed under a screen recording of an agent at work.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Door Hiss 01
sounds.desc: A sharp bright pneumatic hiss that fades over half a second, like a sci-fi door sliding open, for a panel, card or window opening.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Door Hiss 02
sounds.desc: An alternate half-second sci-fi door-open air hiss with an instant attack, for a UI panel or hologram card opening.

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Door Hiss 03
sounds.desc: A third bright pneumatic door-open hiss that decays quickly, for revealing a futuristic panel or screen.

sounds.name: Thruster Burn 01
sounds.desc: A rocket thruster ignites over about a second, then roars in a steady full-range burn; trim it for a launch or blast-off moment, or as a power-up layer.

sounds.name: Thruster Burn 03
sounds.desc: The brightest thruster ignition, with sub weight and airy hiss, ramping into a steady roaring burn; trim for a launch or power-up moment.

sounds.name: High Air Sweep 01
sounds.desc: Very bright, thin airy sweep of about 0.25 s with almost no body; use as a light-sweep layer on a highlighter swipe or text shine.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: High Air Sweep 02
sounds.desc: Small, very bright air sweep, slightly delayed; use as a tiny shine accent on a caption highlight or logo glint.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Long Air Sweep 01
sounds.desc: Longer bright airy sweep that swells for about 1.5 s to a peak near the end; use for a slow light sweep across a title or glass card.
sounds.credit_line: "UI Clicky Sound and FX Pack" by Gmorkh (https://gmorkh.itch.io/uiscp), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Sci-Fi Magic Glint 01
sounds.desc: A quiet, brighter magical confirm glint with a 1.5 s shimmering tail; use under a logo shine, a premium reveal or a highlight sweep.
sounds.credit_line: "Sci-Fi UI SFX" by Paolo Migliorisi - Urizen Composer (https://opengameart.org/content/sci-fi-ui-sfx), OGA-BY 4.0 (https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/archive/oga-by-40.txt), edited

sounds.name: Machine Dreaming Bed 01
sounds.desc: A gentle 33-second bed of soft interference, periodic signals and occasional digital purrs, for a quiet 'the AI is thinking' or late-night build moment.

sounds.name: Underground Rumble Bed 01
sounds.desc: A deep, steady rumbling ambience of an underground facility that loops seamlessly; lay it low under a tense storytelling section or a dark hook when the music drops.

sounds.name: Charger Coil Whine Loop 01
sounds.desc: A steady tonal laptop-charger coil whine with a touch of low hum, a subtle electrical bed under desk or laptop B-roll.

sounds.name: Computer Hum Loop 01
sounds.desc: A low, steady tonal electrical hum from an idling computer, a dark room-tone bed under late-night desk or tension moments.

sounds.name: Fog Horn Drone Loop 01
sounds.desc: A 10-second looping low digital horn drone with sub weight, for a tense bed under a hook or a 'something is wrong' section.

sounds.name: Glitch Tech Ambience 01
sounds.desc: Distant echoing beeps, glitches and hisses in a quiet looping bed; sits under screen recordings or AI segments to fill dead air with a techy space.

sounds.name: Glitch Tech Ambience 02
sounds.desc: A reverberant computer-room loop of screeches, beeps and static bursts; use as a busy hacker or 'the machines are working' bed under AI segments.

sounds.name: NAS Server Spin Up 01
sounds.desc: A 3.5-minute recording of a NAS booting, with tonal drive and fan whine and a loud spin-up event partway through; cut sections for server-room beds or a 'machine powering on' moment.

sounds.name: Neon Hum Loop 01
sounds.desc: A steady neon-light hum with a little upper buzz, a low electrical bed under tension or ambience.

sounds.name: Neon Hum Loop 02
sounds.desc: A deep, sub-heavy neon-light hum loop, a quiet low drone for tension under a storytelling section.

sounds.name: Router EM Tone Hum 01
sounds.desc: Steady tonal electrical whine from a router with no low end, a seamless loop for a faint tech room tone under screen recordings or a tense AI section.

sounds.name: Space Rumble Loop 01
sounds.desc: A 5-second loopable deep sub rumble, like a large spaceship engine, for a short tension bed under a hook.

sounds.name: Reverse Hiss Suck-In 01
sounds.desc: A half-second bright air hiss that swells and stops sharply, like a sci-fi door sealing shut, to suck into a hard cut or close a panel.

sounds.name: Reverse Hiss Suck-In 02
sounds.desc: An alternate half-second rising pneumatic hiss that cuts off hard, for leading into a smash cut or a panel snapping shut.

sounds.name: Reverse Hiss Suck-In 03
sounds.desc: A third half-second bright hiss that builds and cuts off, for a quick suck-back before a hit or cut.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 01
sounds.desc: Likely a short, raspy 140 ms scratch with a quick decay; use it for a tiny marker tick or a checkmark being drawn.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 02
sounds.desc: Likely a brighter 140 ms scratch that swells toward its end; use it for a quick underline or highlighter flick on text.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 03
sounds.desc: A longer, quieter 0.3 s scratch with a smooth decay; use it for a marker circling a word or a quick doodle drawing on.

sounds.name: Quick Scratch Stroke 04
sounds.desc: A sustained 0.3 s scratch that holds its level before decaying; use it for a highlighter swipe across a headline or a scribble fill.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 01
sounds.desc: A punchy half-second arcade power-up with an instant attack; use for level-up or upgrade jokes.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 02
sounds.desc: A bright arcade power-up of just over half a second; use for an achievement unlock in a gamified edit.

sounds.name: Arcade Power Up 03
sounds.desc: A bright arcade power-up flourish of about 0.65 s; use for 'level up' or achievement moments.

sounds.name: Retro Confirm Jingle 01
sounds.desc: The loudest of the set, a wide-stereo multi-note retro jingle of about 0.9 s; use for a gamified 'level up' or achievement unlock.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Confirm Jingle 02
sounds.desc: A short two-note retro game confirm whose second note peaks around 80 ms, ringing for about 0.7 s; use for achievement or game-reward moments.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Confirm Jingle 03
sounds.desc: A wide-stereo two-note retro game confirm with about 0.7 s of ring; use for gamified achievement unlocks or playful success beats.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Confirm Jingle 04
sounds.desc: A slightly darker wide-stereo two-note retro confirm with a 0.7 s ring; use for achievement or level-up style moments.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Laser Pew 01
sounds.desc: A clean, unclipped quarter-second tonal arcade laser pew for a 'level up' or gamified list beat.

sounds.name: Retro Menu Click 01
sounds.desc: A short retro game-style select click of about a quarter second; use for playful menu selections or gamified lists.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Menu Click 02
sounds.desc: A short retro game-style select click of about a quarter second, slightly softer onset; use for playful selections in a gamified sequence.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Menu Tone 01
sounds.desc: A retro game-style tonal confirm with a half-second decay; use for playful menu selections or achievement-style list items.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited

sounds.name: Retro Menu Tone 02
sounds.desc: A slightly brighter retro game-style confirm tone with a 0.6 s decay; use for gamified selections and playful lists.
sounds.credit_line: "Universal UI Soundpack" by Nathan Gibson (https://cyrex-studios.itch.io/universal-ui-soundpack), CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), edited
